Plugin.Name: Parity Spot Check
Plugin.Overview: Continuously spot-checks your array's parity in the background: picks a random sector offset, runs Unraid's own parity-check engine (mdcmd check nocorrect) over just that stretch, pauses, and repeats with a new random offset, indefinitely, until you turn it off. Always read-only (NOCORRECT) — it never writes to parity, and steps aside automatically if a real parity check or disk rebuild is already running.
